# Vetta 0.6.15
<!-- release-status: released 2026-11-22 -->

## English

### New

- The command menu now opens with ⌘T. Its “In progress” section lists sessions waiting for you, running, or just finished and not yet opened, followed by sessions you opened recently; when searching, sessions you have opened rank first.
- The command menu has a new glass look in light and dark. Rows tag their project or workspace instead of showing a path, and floating buttons start a new session, open or close. Add Project and Manage Sessions match it.
- On macOS, the Dock icon shows how many sessions need you back, whether finished or waiting for an answer, approval or access. The count drops as you open them.

### Improvements

- Searching sessions and expanding a project in the sidebar are much faster after the first time, especially with many sessions.

### Fixes

- In IM chats, a session that is already in use is now reported as busy instead of as an unexpected exit.

### Upgrade notes

- The double-tap ⌘/⌥/⇧ quick panel and its settings are gone; use the command menu (⌘T). ⌘K no longer opens it unless you set that yourself. Plugins can no longer change quick panel settings.

## 中文

### 新增

- 命令面板改用 ⌘T 唤起。顶部「进行中」列出等你回答、运行中和刚完成还没看的会话，下面是最近打开的会话；搜索时打开过的会话排在前面。
- 命令面板换成玻璃质感，深浅色都适配：项目和会话行不再显示路径，改用标签标出所属项目或工作空间；底部浮动按钮可新建会话、打开或关闭。「添加项目」「管理会话」面板同款。
- macOS 的 Dock 图标显示需要你回来看的会话数：跑完了，或在等回答、审批、授权；打开对应会话即减少。

### 改进

- 搜索会话、在侧栏展开项目从第二次起明显更快，会话越多越明显。

### 修复

- IM 对话里会话被占用时，现在会如实提示正在使用，不再误报为意外退出。

### 升级注意

- 双击 ⌘、⌥ 或 ⇧ 唤出的快捷面板及其设置已移除，请改用命令面板（⌘T）。⌘K 不再打开命令面板，除非你自己设过这个快捷键。插件也不能再修改快捷面板的设置。

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/openvetta/open-vetta/compare/v0.6.14...v0.6.15
